title: Reframe sovereignty as effective control, portability and supplier exit
requirements:
- Define minimum exit rights and the evidence demonstrating portability
- State that public control needs exportable data with metadata, terminology versions and model identifiers
- Clarify that autonomy means choice, control and exit rights, not national self-sufficiency
- Require fallback operator, transfer dossier and escrow arrangements for DPI-H components
- Note that adding APIs alone does not achieve supplier independence
- Cover data structures governed by the public authority, configuration portability, key governance and supplier exit
- Recognise regional and external provision under effective governance control
- Address contract, licence and IP implications of renegotiating with suppliers
